name: attempt_id
description: Unique identifier for this materialization attempt. Primary key.

name: video_id
description: Video being materialized. Foreign key to videos.video_id.

name: status
description: Outcome of this attempt: 'complete' | 'blocked_upstream' | 'failed_transient' | 'failed_permanent' | 'failed_parked'. 'complete' is a terminal success. 'blocked_upstream' means the video has no tournament_results row yet; it is retryable and is deliberately excluded from the consecutive-failure count, because the blocking condition is upstream and not the video's fault. 'failed_transient' is retryable and counted toward the retry cap. 'failed_permanent' (invalid duration_seconds, or no videos row) and 'failed_parked' (retry cap reached) are terminal failures. Only 'blocked_upstream' and 'failed_transient' are re-selected. No in-flight states. NOT enforced as an enum by BigQuery - validation lives in application code.

name: status_message
description: Free-form error, block-reason, or status detail. Typically populated on failure or when blocked upstream, to capture the reason. NULL on success.

name: attempted_at
description: Timestamp when this attempt was recorded. Auto-populated on insert via DEFAULT.
